Speeding Vehicle Kills Four Devotees in Andhra Pradesh

A speeding SUV struck and killed four devotees who had stopped for tea near the Kanaka Durga Temple in Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. The incident occurred as the devotees were on their way to the temple.
